name: Accruing a period on a site with no units is refused with a clear reason
title: SC-13-01-02 Accruing a period on a site with no units is refused with a clear reason
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F0
When the manager accrues period "Kasım 2026" with amount 1500.00 and due date "2026-11-10"
Then the request is rejected with a "no units to accrue" error
And no period, no liability and no payment exists for the site
